title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the condition for circular motion as ∂V/∂r = J^2/(mr^3).

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the stability condition as 3J^2/(mr^4) - ∂f/∂r > 0.

title: Final Answer for (c)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must conclude that n < 3 for stability of the circular orbit.

title: Key Reasoning for (a)
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the concept of effective potential and its role in circular motion.

title: Key Reasoning for (b)
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the condition for stability involving the second derivative of the effective potential.

title: Perturbation Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the effects of small perturbations on the circular orbit.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the stability condition derivation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms in the equations have consistent units.
